questions.q: Give directions from Start to the date palm.
From the date palm to the masjid.
Facing right: forwards 3, half turn, forwards 1. Where?
questions.model: Teacher: 3 right, turn to face left, back 1: 2 right.

questions.q: Which turn takes up to right?
Follow the route on the sheet. Which picture do you reach?
questions.a: The date palm (answer on the sheet key)
questions.model: Teacher follows the first two instructions.

questions.q: Write a route from the start to the star.
questions.a: For example forwards 3, quarter turn clockwise, forwards 2

questions.q: Write a shorter route to the same star.
questions.a: Answers will vary; check by following

questions.q: Facing up, which turn faces down?
Big question: can you guide the robot?
questions.a: Yes: give moves and turns in order, one step at a time.
